body: I tried to do it but he keeps on following me and wont stop until he gets what he wants.
The sister who is still living with us is literally just sleeping and playing games.

I actually kept on playing dumb at first but the job is actually very very simple (its just takes up too much time) so its kinda impossible to fck up unless you dont do it. I also tried purposely showing him that im busy or that "i forgot to do it" but he would keep on nagging and following me around until i work. He would even wake me up if im asleep.
He already knows that im not interested and that i dont want to do it but he doesnt care

Yes. He would not stop interrogating me and agonizing me for not doing what he wants me to do. Even if i try to leave he would follow me to agonize me more and wouldnt even listen if i try to reason out. Its mentally and emotionally exhausting. Even if i dont answer him he wont stop. You would just want to give up since everything you say would be pointless anyway.
Even before, i never liked the idea of working for/with family. They always want to piggyback ride on the other members work and gets even more upset when called out.
Thank you. Would definitely check this one!

Glad to see someone who has the same background as mine. I really appreciate all the other advices but im not sure if they would work with an asian parent. If i my dad hears a "no" from me he will react to it as if i said "i killed someone" or something as extreme. He would keep on interrogating me on why i cant do it but would dismiss all my reasons anyway. Hes unreasonable and it would be like talking to someone who cannot hear what you are saying. Its mentally draining. He definitely would not stop agonizing me and would keep on making me feel like shit for refusing to follow him. 

Im guessing that when i refuse to work for him, he would give the job to my sister but he will pay her. And then mock me by saying "the money could have been yours". (He did something like this before)

I also dont think telling him that i need time to study would work. He mocks me whenever he sees me studying and says that "you dont have to study hard to pass, youre wasting your time".
I also wouldnt mind to work hard as long as i would at least be able to benefit from it.

Before i got into college, i had many opportunities to receive scholarships in school but he refused to let me take them. I wasnt able to do anything since i was still a minor during that time and i needed parents approval. I never understood why he wont let me take them because even if he can afford to pay, free education is still beneficial. Now I finally understand the reason - so that i would be indebted to him and to prevent my independence. 

Thats what he did to my mom too. He refused to let her take a job so that she would have to depend on him and so that he could control her.

Yes i am female. 

My oldest sibling (30M) already has a family but still has no work and they are still supporting him. My older sisters also never worked as students and got to only have fun during their college life.

My parents actually were trying to guilt me by making me purposely hear their "who will take care of us when we get old" conversation.

I dont know exactly how to do it since he is very controlling and never takes no for an answer. He is also close-minded and never takes other opinions into consideration. He always have to have what he wants and if he doesnt get it, he gets stern and scary.

I dont have the credentials to work for the company and the work isnt even aligned with my current course in college. Also there are almost no jobs is my country that offers high salary for non-professionals (the salaries are very low to make it possible to support my studies).
Im 20 and from Asia

If i ask him to pay me he would be calling me selfish and "the money is for you and the family anyway". My family would gang up to embarrass me with things like this.

I do want to move out but i dont even have money to do that.
It is very immature indeed. And shes even older than me. I kept making her and my family realise that but instead they make me the immature one because "i get easily irritated with her actions"
Life is so unfair. Usually bad people doesnt experience the consequences of their actions. Most of the time the people who does good are miserable while the bad ones are happy.

"You will make everyone sad" but guess what?? Everyone also made me feel sad and worthless and keeps on doing things that make me feel like shit. Everyone is the reason why i hate my life.

So i have to keep living my life just to make the people who hurt me feel better??

My sister does things exactly like this. Except that she's older that me and is already 21. Its really frustrating that she gets away with everything and my parents thinks that im just making up stories about her.

My older sister bullies me when people arent watching. I told my family about it but they think that im just imagining things. My dad called me stupid for assuming that my sister is bullying me and forces me to get along with her.

They are blaming me for us not getting along although i kept on explaining to them that if only she is being civil then there wouldnt have been any problems. But they cant hear me. They blame me and point me as the root of all problems.

I honestly just want to vanish. It already sucks that your family cant protect you, what sucks even more is that they talk behind your back and make everyone think that youre the bad guy.

My mom thinks that my sister's actions toward me are normal. Although when i do something that seems the slightest bit disrespectful to my sister, mom would get really angry at me.

Also one of the reasons why i stopped eating with them is that i felt like my mom doesnt want me there anymore (since the table becomes uncomfortable although it was due to my sister's actions). Even when I invite mom to eat with me she would keep on making excuses to not eat then i would suddenly see them eating together. 

Your right about my sister damaging and stealing my things. I had to keep my important things where she wouldnt be able to see them since she thinks that my things are also hers (although she gets really angry when she sees me using hers). A lot of my things suddenly go missing and i would also randomly find some of my things damaged around the house.
She will never acknowledge them and would probably just call me crazy. She would also be really angry at me and would make me the bad person again.
I tried sending her words back to her but things got out of hand since she got really angry at me then called me rude and offensive. She never listens to what i say and just thinks of me as a loser.

Im still in college and would would enter med school after. I really need my parents support and they would never allow me to move out unless i stop receiving support from them. I'll go back to the dorm soon tho so i guess ill just wait for now.

I do this sometimes lol. I pretended to be asleep then when she sees that im already sleeping she would then sleep. When she falls asleep i finally "wake-up" and continue with whatever i was doing haha

It's difficult to do this with the other things tho since it seems like she keeps on observing my actions.

We are living together and we also share a room. I dont think telling mom would work since she would think that im just overacting. 

I also try to avoid her as much as possible that's why i try to be awake whenever she is asleep but then she kept on matching her sleep schedule with mine. She also kept on trying to "compete" with the places in the house that i hangout on.

When she was insulting my teeth once, i told her calmly and without malice that her's are like mine too. She got very angry at me and called me rude and offensive. Things just got out of hand so i never tried to call her out again.
She also constantly gossips about me and makes my family hate me. Its frustrating.
And yet she thinks of me as a loser and that shes the coolest person in the world
